name: steam_turbine_exergy_balance
title: Steam turbine exergy balance
summary: Second-law (exergy) analysis of a steam turbine of a ULiège course exercise: steam enters at 3 MPa and 450 °C at 8 kg/s, leaves at 0.2 MPa and 150 °C and loses 300 kW to an ambient at 100 kPa and 25 °C; the model gives the actual and the maximum (reversible) power, the second-law efficiency, the exergy destruction and the specific flow exergy at the inlet.

origin.course: Thermodynamique appliquée (ULiège, MECA0002), repetition session 10, exercise 2 (2022-2023)

verification.reference: EES stored solution of the source file (25 variables, 20 in common with the model), converted with --ees-units
verification.notes: All 20 common variables agree: '20 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001)', largest relative deviation 4.12e-10 (W_dot_t); absolute enthalpies and entropies agree without reference-state offset. Manual unit conversion (K -> °C only). Five EES records are not variables of the model (X_dot_in, X_dot_out, dX_system, dt, eta_II_bis: symbols of the comments and a commented alternative), 13 variables are the added diagram state arrays. The commit part of coolsolve_version is the one recorded by the other models of roadmap batch B-05: this checkout of the CoolSolve repository has no .git directory, so git rev-parse cannot be run.
